name: Neartect
title: Neartect · Design the near space
description: Neartect models how nearby walls, corners, pipes, and gratings colour a microphone's sound: combs, boundary lift, corner bass, and pipe resonance.
socialDescription: Place microphones among walls, corners, pipes, and gratings, from a millimetre to a few metres away, and hear the combs, boundary lift, corner bass, and resonances they add. Listen live and export impulse responses.
imageAlt: Neartect showing surfaces around a microphone
